Thanks for the context — quick read-through:

- Operationally we should post the incoming funds to AR Suspense (GL 1050) when received to avoid premature revenue reversal. Journal suggested: DR Bank EUR 12,300 / CR AR Suspense EUR 12,300, with memo referencing BH-INV-13145.

- If Blue Harbor wants the bounced amount converted to a credit note, we need two downstream actions: (A) issue a credit memo referencing invoice 13145; (B) update the revenue mapping so that the original revenue for 13145 remains recognized if it was already recognized, and then map the credit memo to contra-revenue in the period the credit is issued. That avoids restating revenue for closed periods.

- VAT: since this is an intra-EU customer, conversion to credit note will require issuing a VAT credit with the same VAT treatment as the original invoice. Grace — can you verify whether the original invoice had VAT reversal entries in our EMEA VAT book? If not, issuing a credit now could create a VAT adjustment in the current filing period.

I'll prepare the journal entry as a draft and attach the journal_adj_template completed for accounting review. Approvers: Marcus (tax) and Finance Controller.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Accounting Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Lauren — I pulled the invoice 13145 history. Notes:

- Invoice 13145 was issued 2028-07-28 for EUR 12,300; rev recognition was completed 2028-08-05 (closed period).
- VAT was posted as standard 20% EMEA VAT on orig invoice and captured in VAT book for period Jul-2028.

Recommendations:
1) Post to AR Suspense as Lauren suggested immediately to reflect cash on hand (do not reverse revenue in the July ledger). Journal: DR Bank (suspense clearing) / CR AR Suspense.
2) If customer requests a credit note, issue a credit memo dated the current date and map it to contra-revenue (use account 7300-CR) — do not post a revenue reversal in the original July period. Instead, account in the current period so P&L shows the credit without restating historical revenue.
3) VAT: issuing the credit will require us to file a VAT adjustment in the current period (reduce output tax) and reconcile with Jul-2028 return; Marcus, we'll need your sign-off on the VAT treatment and whether we need to submit an amended return or an adjustment entry in Sep.

I'm attaching the bank acknowledgement you posted and a short trace showing how the remitted amount currently sits on the bank file.

[Attachment: bank_statement_09122028.pdf]
